purpose: 用固定拓扑和固定像素合同批量生产几十种主题的可拼接战场地块，避免每个主题重新设计边缘与交付流程。

topology.rotation_policy: directional pieces are authored per direction; runtime rotation is forbidden for any piece with light, facade, wear or shadow direction
topology.assembly_rule: each logical cell receives exactly one surface or directional piece; no board-wide baked texture; adjacency is resolved by layout coordinates; directional outer-edge facade may overhang outside the board without changing the logical or hit footprint

locked_invariants.footprint: the full 32x32 ground canvas is one walkable cell
locked_invariants.perimeter: surface pieces do not bake a repeated dark cell frame; the shared tactical-grid layer supplies visible cell boundaries, while material seams remain sparse internal features
locked_invariants.lighting: single fixed upper-left light for every theme and every piece
locked_invariants.value_hierarchy: center surface low contrast; border and collision silhouette readable; gameplay overlays remain highest contrast
locked_invariants.density: three to five connected material clusters plus at most two controlled wear cues; no high-frequency dither or isolated noise
locked_invariants.palette: neutral material base first; cyan only for active aether; rust red only for hostile or damage semantics; safety yellow only for service, warning or loot
locked_invariants.single_native_source: one 32 PPU native asset is reused at 1x, 2x or 4x integer display scale; no separate resolution companion
locked_invariants.directional_edge_identity: the top 32x32 is the approved theme surface copied exactly; only the exterior facade overhang is independently generated and normalized, preventing a material jump on the boundary row
locked_invariants.ground_window_normalization: an opaque ground-material source may decode to a larger stable logical field; the deterministic centered 32x32 window, or a recorded phase-aligned window origin when needed to avoid clipping a regular brick rhythm, is the formal surface delivery. It records logical bounds and source hash and may neither resize, interpolate, paint, add colours nor alter any selected logical pixel. For a regular repeating brick/material field whose repetition makes the generic non-repeating-subject confidence ambiguous, a reviewer may declare the observed square macro-pixel pitch; this path remains REVIEW_READY and requires explicit human pixel-scale, material and application approval before FORMAL_CANDIDATE
locked_invariants.grid_layer: a shared 1-native-pixel tactical-grid overlay supplies visible cell edges at 1x, 2x and 4x; it is not baked into ground materials and has no terrain, collision or selection semantics

prompt_contract.prefix: single isolated battlefield floor piece for a near-modern aether-industrial tactical map; orthographic top-down; one logical cell only
required: visibly coarse pixel art with large connected clusters

production_gates.name: theme_lock
production_gates.rule: freeze theme parameters and one reference tile before batch generation

production_gates.name: source
production_gates.rule: one independent image-model generation per formal surface or facade; directional-edge delivery composes the approved surface top with the independently generated facade overhang and records both component sources and hashes

production_gates.name: normalize
production_gates.rule: decode the material lattice without geometric resizing; a stable opaque field may yield its recorded centered 32x32 logical window without changing selected pixels; deliver surfaces at 32x32 and directional outer edges at 32x40; hard alpha, limited palette, Point/Clamp

production_gates.name: batch_contact
production_gates.rule: review 1x, 4x, grayscale, checker and a randomized 12x9 assembly contact before Unity

production_gates.name: human_style
production_gates.rule: reject the whole theme batch if the reference tile breaks seam, light or value invariants

production_gates.name: runtime_contact
production_gates.rule: verify 1920x1080 and 960x540 using the same native asset at integer scale; no board texture

production_gates.name: promotion
production_gates.rule: only after stable GUID, importer and runtime evidence may a piece become FORMAL

rework_policy.regenerate_scope: regenerate only the rejected piece unless it violates a locked theme invariant; invariant failure invalidates the full theme batch
never: do not generate a full board as a production source
do not rotate directional pieces at runtime
do not create a new border grammar per theme
do not use palette reduction to hide noisy structure
do not resize, interpolate, repaint or synthesize the selected ground window
